chunks: He is Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Hasan al-Tusi, the epithet deriving from Tus, one of the cities of Khorasan.

key_terms.الطُّوسِيُّ: al-Tusi — nisba (relational epithet) denoting origin from the city of Tus
key_terms.خُرَاسَانَ: Khorasan — historical region of northeastern Iran, a major centre of Islamic scholarship
key_terms.نِسْبَةً: attribution/nisba — the relational epithet linking a person to their place of origin

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Tusi and what is the origin of his nisba al-Tusi?
ai.summary: This opening entry of the biographical chapter establishes the full name and geographical origin of Sheikh al-Tusi, the great Shia jurist and author of Tahdhib al-Ahkam. His nisba 'al-Tusi' is explicitly explained as a reference to the city of Tus in Khorasan, a major centre of Islamic learning in northeastern Iran.
